deviations.why: Asks for tests against a published or independently computed reference; no published iNEXT numbers were reachable (CRAN vignette blocked, no R).
deviations.did: Independent Python reference by different routes (scipy hypergeom, mpmath Lerch phi, scikit-bio) plus Monte Carlo subsamples and a coverage simulation; README states plainly that no side-by-side iNEXT run was done.
deviations.result: Agreement to 1e-10; simulation found and fixed a real interval bug.

notes: Explore idea: species diversity (Chao1/ACE, Hill numbers q=0,1,2, rarefaction/extrapolation by size and coverage, coverage-standardised comparison, iNEXT conventions) as a research-algorithm tool; 0 of 1,408 other venture READMEs mentioned rarefaction, Chao1, species richness, Hill numbers or Shannon. Example: Portal Project rodents 2016-2025 (CC0, GitHub raw). Reference: scipy 1.17.1 / mpmath 1.4.1 / scikit-bio 0.7.4 on 13 assemblages to 1e-10; 20,000-subsample Monte Carlo within 1%. Coverage simulation (1,000 x 4): rarefied S 92-98%, extrapolated S 87-99%, Shannon 85-96%, Simpson 90-94%, Chao1 50-93% (lower bound). The simulation caught a clip of q=1,2 intervals at the observed value that cut q=2 coverage to 69%; removed. Not run against iNEXT itself (no R): next check. No separate agent doc in docs/reports: the venture README and eval/README carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
